paragraphs: Rabban Gamliel was so called, as in Sanhedrin 11b.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied verb נקראו and epithet are plural, while the notice identifies Gamliel. The stored Vilna Rashi on Sanhedrin11b explicitly identifies the forceful early ones as Rabban Gamliel and contrasts his son Rabban Shimon. The stored Davidson11a–11b scalars supply the contrast, not that commentary identification. No and his generation is supplied by the notice.
